### 🚀 Getting Started

```bash
# Clone the repo
git clone https://github.com/sendtoshailesh/my-git-learnings.git

# Open in your editor
cd my-git-learnings
code .

# Start learning - open README.md or pick any guide!
```

### 🎓 Learning Paths

**Beginner Path** (4 weeks)
- Git vs GitHub
- Repository & Commits
- Branching Fundamentals
- Clone vs Fork

**Intermediate Path** (4 weeks)
- Merge Conflicts
- Rebasing vs Merging
- Code Review
- GitHub Actions

**Advanced Path** (varies)
- Cherry-pick & Advanced Ops
- Git Hooks & Automation
- Git Workflows
- Team Management
